name: Ui
lead: Titles, chat, the action bar, boss bars, the sidebar and the tab list: for everyone in a room (the `ui` global, or `room.ui`), or for one player (`player.ui`, the same calls). "Everyone" below is one player on `player.ui`.

functions.name: title
functions.signature: ui.title(opts: { title: Text ?, subtitle: Text ?, color: Ink ?, fade_in: number ?, stay: number ?, fade_out: number ?, })
functions.description: Shows a title and subtitle to everyone in the room; fades and stay are in seconds.

functions.name: actionbar
functions.description: Shows a line above the hotbar to everyone in the room.

functions.name: bossbar
functions.signature: ui.bossbar(opts: { title: Text ?, color: BarColor ?, progress: number ? }?) → Bar
functions.description: Shows a boss bar to everyone in the room and returns its handle; progress 0..1. 1.8 reads the title on its action bar.

functions.name: sidebar
functions.signature: ui.sidebar(opts: ({ title: Text ?, lines: { Text }? } | false)?)
functions.description: Sets the sidebar for everyone in the room; lines run top to bottom and only changed lines are sent. nil or false removes the sidebar.

functions.name: tab
functions.description: Sets the player list's header and footer for everyone in the room.

functions.name: box
functions.signature: ui.box(opts: { id: string ?, width: number, height: number, color: Ink ?, radius: number ? }) → LayoutNode
functions.description: The pieces of a layout (see "Layouts"). Sizes are pixels of the game's own HUD; a box is 1 to 256 a side. An item with an `id` is live.

functions.name: image
functions.signature: ui.image(opts: { id: string ?, image: Texture, color: Ink ? }) → LayoutNode

functions.name: label
functions.signature: ui.label(opts: { id: string ?, text: string ?, width: number ?, align: LayoutAlign ?, color: Ink ? }) → LayoutNode
functions.description: Words in the client's own letters, space to `~`. Give a label whose words change a `width`.

functions.name: row
functions.signature: ui.row(opts: { gap: number ?, align: LayoutAlign ?, [number]: LayoutNode }) → LayoutNode
functions.description: The children are the list part: `ui.row{ gap = 4, a, b }`.

functions.name: column
functions.signature: ui.column(opts: { gap: number ?, align: LayoutAlign ?, [number]: LayoutNode }) → LayoutNode

functions.name: define
functions.signature: ui.define(name: string, opts: { anchor: "bottom" ?, margin: number ?, [number]: LayoutNode }) → Layout
functions.description: A layout of one child, centred over the hotbar with its bottom edge `margin` pixels above the screen's (40, or 25 when `hide_hud` takes the hearts and the food away). While the pack loads only.

fields.name: kit
fields.description: What a dialog is made of (see "Dialogs"): row, column, stack, space, text, image, and window, button, tabs, close, badge, dot, progress, divider, card, grid, theme, mix and SCREEN.

title: ui global · type Ui
